needKey: Add your Factdock personal API key in Settings → Factdock first.
busy: A Factdock search is already running.
tool_web: Standard search (primary sources on the web)
zoneDesc: Required. Factdock searches in that country's own language.
langDesc: Titles and summaries are shown in this language.
chooseZoneFirst: Choose a country to see the price.
priceOne: This search costs {n} credits. No credits are used until you press Search.
priceSphere: A language sphere costs {lo}–{hi} credits depending on its number of countries. No credits are used until you press Search.
searchingHint: This can take a minute or two. You can keep writing.
emptyHint: Search with Factdock, then put any result into your note with its source.
already: This source is already in the note.
apiKeyDesc: Issue a key on the API page of the Factdock app (paid plans). It starts with fdu_.
folderDesc: "New note" creates one note per result in this folder.
about: Your search terms are sent to Factdock (fact-dock.com) only when you start a search. Nothing else from your vault is sent. Saving results into notes is free; each search uses credits from your Factdock plan.
errNetwork: Could not reach Factdock. Check your connection.
errServer: Factdock is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
